description: A persistent open sore on the foot caused by tissue breakdown.
causes: Pressure, trauma, impaired circulation, neuropathy, infection, or other chronic disease

appearance.general: A persistent defect in the skin of the foot that may have surrounding callus, inflammation, or necrotic tissue depending on cause.

warning_signs: Increasing pain, redness, warmth, pus, fever, spreading inflammation, black tissue, or rapidly worsening ulcer requires prompt medical evaluation.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss diabetes status, sensation, circulation, footwear, and duration of the ulcer.
